newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish minister Mervyn Taylor stands down.
newsitem.headline: Irish minister Mervyn Taylor stands down.

text.p: Ireland's Equality and Law Reform Minister Mervyn Taylor said on Wednesday that he would not contest this year's general election.
Taylor, 65, said he was retiring from politics after serving as a Dublin constituency member of the Irish parliament for 16 years
He is the 15th member of the current 166-strong Dublin Parliament to leave politics.
An election has to be staged in Ireland on or before November, 1997. -- Dublin newsroom + 353 1 660 3377
